notes.title: Game balance changed and some fixes
notes.content:
As a first-time game developer, balance is not my strength, so I think the game was very hard. To fix that, now when someone creates a new save, it will start with 10 lives instead of 5, and the level up price scale is 1 instead of 2.

I also fix some bugs, the repeated sound on Esnowli fight is no logen running, the music is working on Esnowli fight too, and now the controller support will work better.

notes.title: Small changes to the UI
notes.content: Now when a button is selected, the color changed to yellow, to make it easier to navigate without the cursor.

notes.title: Changing email from main menu
notes.content: This is a minor change. The first email is also mine, but I will focuns only on this email now.
